issues.description: The example Main.java in the template calls a method named feed() on the Farm instance, but the problem statement and the solution implementation require/use feedAllAnimals(). Specifically: template/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Main.java has a call to farm.feed() (line 20), while the problem statement describes a Farm.feedAllAnimals() method (problem_statement.md lines 107-112) and the solution defines public void feedAllAnimals() in solution/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java (lines 27-31). This name mismatch will cause a compilation error or confusion if students uncomment the Main example or follow the example usage.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template and specification consistent. Either (A) change the call in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Main.java from farm.feed() to farm.feedAllAnimals(), or (B) add a small public void feed() method in the template Farm.java that delegates to feedAllAnimals() (or add a feedAllAnimals() stub in the template) so the example Main compiles and matches the problem description. Update comments/examples accordingly.
